block.arguments: {"code":"let counter: number = 1; const alias = { value: counter }; function increment() { return ++counter }; class Box { [await Promise.resolve(\"read\")]() { return counter } };","description":"Declare Script state with computed await"}

block.name: run_code
block.arguments: {"code":"counter++; Harness.inspect(\"retained\", new Box().read()); Harness.inspect(JSON.stringify(({ count: increment(), alias: alias.value, answer: await(Promise.resolve(42)) }), null, 2))","description":"Reuse retained Script declarations"}

block.name: run_code
block.arguments: {"code":"const cwdResult = await tools.bash({command:\"pwd\",description:\"Read working directory\"}); Harness.inspect(JSON.stringify(({ sameDirectory: cwdResult.stdout.text.trim() === process.cwd(), count: counter }), null, 2))","description":"Call a host binding from Script"}

block.name: run_code
block.arguments: {"code":"process.exit(7)","description":"End a separate temporary Script process","sandbox_permissions":"danger-full-access","justification":"Approve a separate temporary process to check that its exit leaves retained variables intact."}
